title: What if a city-killer asteroid hit the Moon? 🌕
subject: moon
description:
Would you have stayed up to watch it? 👇

What would happen if an asteroid hit the Moon? Asteroid 2024 YR4 had a 4.3% chance of hitting it on December 22, 2032, until new James Webb Space Telescope data ruled it out in March 2026.

Sources: NASA Science (2024 YR4 updates, Mar 2026), Wikipedia (2024 YR4: Moon impact estimates), Live Science (Mar 2026)
tags: what if an asteroid hit the moon

scenes.text: You might have seen the Moon flash in daylight.
In 2025, NASA gave asteroid 2024 YR4, as tall as a 15-story building, a 4.3 percent chance of hitting the Moon in December 2032.
The blast would equal about 340 Hiroshima bombs and leave a crater up to 2 kilometers wide.
About 100,000 tons of rock would fly off the Moon. Some could reach Earth as a meteor shower.
In March 2026, Webb ruled it out. YR4 will miss the Moon by about 21,200 kilometers.
